summary: Our latest incident analysis of 44 bug reports and incidents reveals a mix of UI, functionality, and performance issues, with 22 of these incidents relating to Copilot, Agents, and Mermaid features, indicating a need for improved integration with the core VS Code product. The top risk area is Agents functionality, with 7 high-severity incidents reported, posing a significant threat to data reliability and user experience. To mitigate this risk, I recommend that the team prioritize stabilizing Agents functionality, focusing on resolving the identified issues to prevent data loss and unexpected behavior, which will require approximately 2-3 weeks of dedicated effort. Additionally, addressing the 8 medium-severity Copilot issues and 5 high-severity Chronicle SQL issues will also be crucial to improving the overall user experience and satisfaction. By allocating resources to these key areas, we can significantly reduce the number of incidents and improve the product's reliability and performance, with a target of reducing high-severity incidents by 30% within the next 6 weeks.
